query.raw_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 42 AND total_amount >= 450.00
query.canonical_template: select * from orders where customer_id = ? and total_amount >= ?
query.note: >=  is preserved by canonicalize_sql (not collapsed to >). T9 is structurally distinct from T3 (DEV, uses >).

candidate_set.note: Composite baseline. Zero TRAIN support. ID 7 (T3, DEV) has this key but is excluded from TRAIN corpus.
3 TRAIN matches from T2 (total_amount > ?). Supports both Policy B and C accumulation.
3 TRAIN matches from T1 (customer_id = ?). Supports both Policy B and C accumulation.

policy_a.name: Planner-Only Baseline
policy_a.rule: Select the unique candidate where is_baseline == True

policy_b.name: Similarity-Based Selection
policy_b.rule: Rank by composite_score = hypopg_cost_improvement + (alpha * similarity_support). Tiebreak: hypopg_cost, is_baseline, candidate_id.
policy_b.fallback_condition: Would fall back only if zero TRAIN cases matched any candidate key (not the case here)
policy_b.note: Selection depends on whether similarity boost for (customer_id) or (total_amount) raises their scores above 87.55. Must be computed and frozen pre-measurement.

policy_c.name: Outcome-Aware Selection
policy_c.rule: Filter to verified measured cases. Rank by hypopg_cost_improvement + (beta * outcome_support). Asymmetric penalty lambda_reg for regressions.
policy_c.fallback_condition: Would fall back only if zero verified measured cases matched any candidate key (not the case here)
policy_c.note: Selection depends on accumulated (sim * delta) for (total_amount) and (customer_id) vs. composite base of 87.55. Must be computed and frozen pre-measurement.

oracle.definition: Candidate with maximum realized runtime_improvement_percent measured independently for all 3 eligible candidates

measurement_protocol.index_isolation: Each candidate created and dropped independently before the next is measured
measurement_protocol.cleanup_verification: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname LIKE 'idx_autodba_p8_%' must equal 0 after each teardown

oracle.independence_guarantee: Oracle is determined after policy selections are frozen. Oracle result does not influence policy selections, parameters, or retrieval corpus.

sequencing_protocol: Step 4: Load T9 candidate pool (3 candidates, as specified)
Step 9: [CHECKPOINT] Verify selection file written and timestamped
Step 10: Physically measure candidate 1 (composite), teardown, verify cleanup
Step 11: Physically measure candidate 2 (total_amount), teardown, verify cleanup
Step 12: Physically measure candidate 3 (customer_id), teardown, verify cleanup
Step 14: Compare policy selections vs oracle

leakage_controls.template_isolation: T9 hash verified absent from all existing partitions (TRAIN, DEV, Phase 6D TEST, Phase 7 templates)
leakage_controls.retrieval_boundary: Policy B/C access only TRAIN IDs 1-6. DEV ID 7 excluded despite having composite candidate key.
leakage_controls.outcome_isolation: T9 physical measurements never written to optimization_memories
leakage_controls.oracle_sequencing: Policy selections frozen and timestamped before any CREATE INDEX executed
leakage_controls.parameter_isolation: alpha, beta, lambda_reg locked from Phase 6D; no tuning on T9 outcome

success: Policy selections A/B/C frozen and written
early_stop_conditions: HypoPG validation fails for all 3 candidates: document and stop
Physical measurement regression: record as-is, do not re-run or adjust parameters

methodological_limitation.statement: This is currently ONE informative multi-candidate unseen-template case. One case is not sufficient for a strong comparative conclusion about policy superiority. The experiment can demonstrate whether policy divergence occurs and its direction, but cannot establish statistical significance or generalizability.
methodological_limitation.minimum_for_statistical_claim: 5-10 independent multi-candidate TEST cases across diverse templates and tables
